definition.name: Packaging / Artwork · internal candidate v1
definition.description: GTI Packaging blueprint gti-packaging-artwork revision 1; source 2026-09-29 SHA-256 4d86f90d173a406ad9f3a5ffbba7ce55776b5d209f4bc2a0e4653f299d61b944. UNAPPROVED CANDIDATE. Internal evidence review only. Official rollout blocked: repeated per-file/market/unit validation, mandatory concept-task gates, Purchase/CEO/all-Executor approvals, vendor/CERBER/contract/dispatch services, verified Toolio entry and document automation are unavailable. Initial and Final Concept work uses manually created Universal Tasks. Requiredness and routing are proposed. Stage completion is not project completion: Director-approved per-project document policy, actual Owner request and separate Director final decision remain mandatory. No automatic archive or official designation.

gaps.missing: Source does not enumerate required/optional flags for every field. Candidate requiredness, file allowlists/count limits and review routing need business confirmation.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Proposed internal validation choices are explicit; none is an approved GTI standard.

gaps.missing: No repeatable SKU/market/final-file/production-unit/sample matrix or per-row conditional applicability and reason validation.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Project-level typed summary plus attached detailed registers; internal review of registers does not enforce every row.

gaps.missing: Initial/Final Concept Tasker exists, but no configured task-to-stage completion gate, concept minimum count or revision-round contract enforcement.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Create concept tasks manually through existing Tasker. Reviewed creative evidence is a stage-file requirement; task status never masquerades as a gate.

gaps.missing: No toolkit rendering, Director-only removal of an embedded document note, linked-project launch or approved master layout.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Retain the default note in guidance; independently review an uploaded toolkit. Its contents are human-reviewed, not automatically inspected.

gaps.missing: No prefilled document generation, signing, two-party acceptance or runtime external submission. Legal wording still needs counsel review.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Upload internal evidence; use the existing separately Director-approved per-project completion-document policy. Stage files never replace that policy.

gaps.missing: No template durations, backward scheduling, automatic starter tasks, stage-blocking tasks, budget ledger/alerts, leave delegation or operational external notifications.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Dates and budget are captured values. Tasks are manually created; no automation or delegated Director rights are claimed.

gaps.missing: Source automatic closing/archiving and gate overrides cannot replace approved V2 governance; ratings/archive publication remain unsupported.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: All stages completed still requires explicit document policy, actual Owner request and separate Director final decision. No automatic archive.

tasker.instructions: Manually create manager-owned Initial Concept tasks; request distinct numbered directions, pack views, tipping paper, summary page and horizontal PDF. Use existing independent review and retained revisions. Minimum counts/rounds and brief acceptance are not automated.

Manually create Final Concept tasks, selecting eligible exact Initial Concept evidence where authorized; develop colour variants, 3D and all components. Existing Tasker independent review applies. No automatic stage gate or mandatory legacy stage.

blueprint.revisionPolicy: Increment blueprint revision for any content/policy change; retain semantic IDs for unchanged meaning. Renamed meanings require new IDs and an explicit source migration map. Drafts are copies; published versions and existing runtime pins are never overwritten.
